dedupe_keys.name: california climate risk and adaptation index metric files and metadata v1

description: Eagle Rock Analytics publishes version 1 metric files for the California Climate Risk and Adaptation Index. Zenodo provides six archives and a README free under CC BY 4.0. CSV files cover input metrics, aggregated indicators, domain values, an equal-weighted composite index and custom-weighted scenarios. Metadata describe transformations for wildfire, extreme heat, inland flooding, drought and sea-level risk alongside community capacity. These inputs can screen social and built-environment vulnerability in adaptation simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these archived metric files. Coverage is California, with an index release completed in December 2024. Composite scores depend on selected indicators and weights; they do not measure the failure probability of individual infrastructure assets. Source vintages and local applicability require checking in the metadata. No archive was downloaded or weighted index recalculated.
